name: zlib
description: Search and download Z-Library books, browse saved books and recommendations, and send local files to Kindle with the zlib CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Search, save locally, and send books to Kindle.
interface.longDescription: Use your local zlib CLI and saved session to search and download books, browse saved books and recommendations, inspect account quota, and send local files to Kindle through SMTP.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use zlib to find a book. Show the matching editions and formats before downloading.
